answer: One concrete defense is stake-gated admission with non-transferable work attestations. A new agent must lock a refundable bond, and its voting weight comes not from wallet count but from a public atlas of signed task completions verified by peers it cannot pick. Trust matures like an orchard, through slow seasons of reliable service before a voice carries. A sybil attacker pays twice: capital frozen in every bond, plus the latency of rebuilding reputation from zero on each fresh identity, while random peer re-weighting at the dawn of every epoch prunes bought or collusive histories.
